correctness.rationale: The source Gram identity gives \(\|y_n\|^2=n^{-2}\sum_{i,j}\rho_i\rho_j e^{-\delta^2(H_{i-1}-H_{j-1})^2}\). Since \(\rho_n\to e^{-\delta^2\pi^2/6}\), Cesàro convergence removes the radial factors at vanishing averaged error. Away from the first \(\varepsilon n\) indices, the harmonic-number expansion is uniform and turns the remaining bounded kernel into a Riemann sum for the double integral over \([0,1]^2\); the discarded strips have normalized mass at most \(2\varepsilon\). Symmetry and the substitution \(s=rt\) reduce the double integral to \(\int_0^1e^{-\delta^2(\log r)^2}dr\), and \(u=-\log r\) gives the stated erfc form. This proves the exact positive norm limit without asserting vector norm convergence.
